transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

No, it is likely not broken because most fan ovens have a cooling fan that runs for ten to thirty minutes after use to protect the controls. This is normal behaviour, but if you hear grinding or rattling noises from inside the cavity while it runs, that could indicate a loose blade or motor issue. To check this safely, please switch off the oven at the wall and unplug it once the fan has finally stopped to ensure there are no unusual sounds when it was running. If it ran quietly until now, you can simply plug it back in and use it as normal.
ok its still running at the moment, just a soft whirr no grinding or rattling. do i still need to unplug it when it stops or is it fine to leave it?

It is perfectly fine to leave it plugged in once the fan stops on its own. The soft whirr you hear right now suggests the cooling system is working normally, which is common for ovens to run for up to 30 minutes after being switched off. If you are worried about a fault, you can check if the oven was set to a high temperature or a "fast heat" mode, as these keep the unit hotter for longer. You might also want to ensure no heavy items were left inside that could be trapping heat and extending the cooling time.
